body.statement: For each active \(j=(C,s)\in J\), each fixed \( (\rho,\theta_j)\), and every \(u>\alpha\), \(\min_{h\in H}\Pi_j(\rho,\theta_j,h_s)\ge u\) if and only if \(\Pi_j(\rho,\theta_j,\ell_s)\ge u\), where \(\Pi_j\) is conditional on the complete signed event \(E_{n,C}(\rho)\). Hence the maximin value and every globally optimal design are unchanged when \(H\) is replaced by its least-coordinate vector \(\ell\).
body.justification: This eliminates an infinite alternative-set optimization without imposing coordinatewise monotonicity below size.
body.gap: No inspected enrichment or selective-inference result gives an exact above-size least-coordinate reduction for arbitrary compact positive alternatives.
body.consumer: Designers can specify a clinically meaningful compact uncertainty set without introducing a numerical inner minimization.
